import Pkg
haskey(Pkg.project().dependencies, "CUDA") || Pkg.add("CUDA")
using CUDA
using LinearAlgebra
CUDA.allowscalar(false)

using JSON3

function initstacks_dotprod_b()
    return nothing
end

function dotprod_b(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_n)
    for i_x = 1:i_n
        loss[1] = loss[1] + u[i_x] * v[i_x]
    end
    for i_x = i_n:-1:1
        ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + v[i_x] * lossb[1]
        vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + u[i_x] * lossb[1]
    end
    return nothing
end

function initstacks_dotprod_b_cuda()
    return nothing
end

function dotprod_b_cuda(loss, lossb, u, ub, v, vb, i_n)
    nthread_per_block = 256
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, loss, u, v)
    @cuda threads = nthread_per_block blocks = cld(div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1, nthread_per_block) cuda_kernel_dotprod_b_2!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_dotprod_b_1!(i_n, loss, u, v)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(i_n - 1, 1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = 1 + (__tid - 1)
    CUDA.@atomic loss[1] += u[i_x] * v[i_x]
    return nothing
end

function cuda_kernel_dotprod_b_2!(i_n, lossb, u, ub, v, vb)
    __tid = ((blockIdx()).x - 1) * (blockDim()).x + (threadIdx()).x
    if __tid > div(1 - i_n, -1) + 1
        return nothing
    end
    i_x = i_n + (__tid - 1) * -1
    ub[i_x] = ub[i_x] + v[i_x] * lossb[1]
    vb[i_x] = vb[i_x] + u[i_x] * lossb[1]
    return nothing
end

function _val_init_stacks_local(fn, extra_args)
    r = fn(extra_args...)
    r === nothing && return ()
    r isa Tuple && return r
    return (r,)
end

_relerr_scalar(a, b) = abs(a - b) / max(abs(a), abs(b), 1.0)
_relerr_arr(a, b) = maximum(abs.(a .- b) ./ max.(abs.(a), abs.(b), 1.0))

i_n = 4
__base_loss = Float64[-0.1156197534060024, -2.4473750742065024, 0.4971078193937997, -0.433141365683395]
__base_u = Float64[0.6142714381440131, -1.721318268387077, -0.10401476540273433, -0.4577614967310088]
__base_v = Float64[0.49866314459178895, -0.1630381001093933, 0.41779568981015375, 0.3056562920175763]
__seed_loss = [Float64[-0.3862219341808605, 1.4250391849602908, 0.39287685621685686, 1.4015195155486304], Float64[1.2355010459648779, -0.1156197534060024, -2.4473750742065024, 0.4971078193937997], Float64[0.3056562920175763, -0.15997740327702575, -1.3025577181754877, -0.4915052923359896]]
__seed_u = [Float64[-0.24512335779924074, 0.6289492200250899, 0.4416844805663838, 0.46926278075254535], Float64[-0.433141365683395, 0.6142714381440131, -1.721318268387077, -0.10401476540273433], Float64[-0.1650084233660335, 1.0511580653156527, 0.518477024568639, -1.2083824743425366]]
__seed_v = [Float64[0.19250351087574227, 0.4589107533721674, 0.8756621071744272, -0.566014922684637], Float64[-0.4577614967310088, 0.49866314459178895, -0.1630381001093933, 0.41779568981015375], Float64[0.7983108527981141, -0.6698307990733118, -0.24426828585544647, -1.2212016493344575]]
max_rel_err = 0.0
for __trial in 1:3
  loss_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_loss); loss_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial])
  loss_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_loss)); loss_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_loss[__trial]))
  u_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_u); u_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial])
  u_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_u)); u_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_u[__trial]))
  v_val_cpu = deepcopy(__base_v); v_sh_cpu = deepcopy(__seed_v[__trial])
  v_val_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__base_v)); v_sh_gpu = CuArray(deepcopy(__seed_v[__trial]))
  stacks_cpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_dotprod_b, Any[])
  stacks_gpu = _val_init_stacks_local(initstacks_dotprod_b_cuda, Any[])
  ret_cpu = dotprod_b(loss_val_cpu, loss_sh_cpu, u_val_cpu, u_sh_cpu, v_val_cpu, v_sh_cpu, i_n, stacks_cpu...)
  ret_gpu = dotprod_b_cuda(loss_val_gpu, loss_sh_gpu, u_val_gpu, u_sh_gpu, v_val_gpu, v_sh_gpu, i_n, stacks_gpu...)
  ret_cpu_t = ()
  ret_gpu_t = ()
  local_max = 0.0
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_sh_cpu, Array(loss_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(loss_val_cpu, Array(loss_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_sh_cpu, Array(u_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(u_val_cpu, Array(u_val_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(v_sh_cpu, Array(v_sh_gpu)))
  local_max = max(local_max, _relerr_arr(v_val_cpu, Array(v_val_gpu)))
  global max_rel_err = max(max_rel_err, local_max)
end
println(JSON3.write(Dict("kernel" => "dotprod", "rtol" => 2.5e-14, "ok" => max_rel_err <= 2.5e-14, "max_rel_err" => max_rel_err, "device" => string(CUDA.name(CUDA.device())))))
